title: Epom Ad Server Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Epom Ad Server adapter

host.description: Serving host of the publisher's Epom Ad Server deployment, as a bare hostname with an optional port

placementKey.description: Placement identifier, from the placement's invocation-code tab in the Epom UI

channel.description: Epom channel: publisher traffic-slice label used for channel targeting, reporting and tracking-URL propagation. Sent as imp.ext.epom_as.channel. An empty value is ignored.

customParams.description: Epom custom parameters for custom targeting and creative macros. Merged into imp.ext.data, where keys already on the impression win.

bidFloor.description: CPM floor for this impression, applied only when no floor has already been resolved on imp.bidfloor. 0 means no floor.

bidFloorCur.description: Currency of bidFloor as an ISO-4217 code. Defaults to USD.
